description: Twilio programmable communications REST APIs for voice, messaging and account management.
auth_notes: HTTP Basic with API key SID as username and API key secret as password; keys created in Twilio Console or via API.
gate_detail: Developer signs up (Start for free) and creates an API key in the Console. Trial limits and paid-usage requirements for production are not detailed in the sources.
api_scope: REST APIs for accounts, phone numbers, Voice calls, Messaging SMS/MMS, usage and credentials; official SDKs available.
mcp_notes: Official docs-search MCP server, no auth needed; execute-ready OAuth tools are only planned.
blocker_detail: No approval or sales gate stated for API keys.

evidence.quote: Use your API key SID as the username and your API key secret as the password.

Twilio's Voice API enables you to make, retrieve, control and monitor calls.

uncertainties: Free trial restrictions and production upgrade requirements are not stated.
